transcript:
SOURCE: Fathom (via HubSpot internal notes) — https://fathom.video/share/bdxaWevTTs7DYxduzf8Z96aCWPGauoeP

AI Meeting Summary ✨

Generated by Fathom // View Recording (47 mins - No highlights)

Meeting Purpose

To explore smbteam.com's marketing services for RMD Law.

Key Takeaways

Performance Dip: RMD Law's new case signings dropped from ~50/month to 30/month. The goal is to regain consistency and add 10+ cases/month.

Agency Change: The firm will part with its strategy agency (Neil Patel's Excel team) by the end of August, creating an immediate need for a new partner.

Budget & Channel Shift: The $80k/month budget is heavily reliant on Yelp ($50k/mo), a channel with volatile results (5-20 signups). smbteam.com proposes reallocating this to more consistent channels like social media and LSAs.

Strategic Growth: RMD Law is expanding into employment law and new markets (Austin, Seattle, Dallas/Houston). A key decision is whether to launch a new website or integrate the practice area into the existing site.

Topics

RMD Law's Marketing Challenges

Performance Decline: New case signings dropped from a 12-month streak of growth (~50/mo) to a projected 30/mo, creating an urgent need for new strategies.

Current Agency Structure:

Strategy: Neil Patel's Excel team (contract ends Aug. 2026).

Execution: An overseas agency handles content, dev, and link building.

Paid Ads: Managed in-house by the CMO.

Paid Ad Performance Issues:

Yelp: $50k/mo budget yields volatile results (5-20 signups).

Google Search: Priced out of PI keywords (CPCs ~$250-300).

LSAs: Underperforming due to aged accounts and poor ranking, resulting in low-quality leads.

ChatGPT Ads: Limited by a lack of scheduling and state-level geo-targeting, requiring a custom Claude agent for control.

Strategic Growth Initiatives:

Employment Law: Launching a new practice area; the key decision is whether to build a new site or integrate it into the existing one.

Market Expansion: Targeting Austin (new), Seattle, Dallas, and Houston.

Brand Awareness: Seeking to improve social media presence and consistency.

smbteam.com's Proposed Solution

Multi-Channel Strategy: Shift from an 80% SEO focus to a brand awareness model using PPC, LSAs, video, and social media.

Budget Reallocation: Propose moving the $50k/mo Yelp budget to more consistent channels like social ads and LSAs.

Website Redesign: Build a new website (45-60 day timeline) to improve SEO, AI visibility, and provide a clean platform for the employment law launch.

AI Avatars: Offer AI avatars for scalable content creation, addressing authenticity concerns with high-quality examples.

Review Management: Provide training to improve review velocity and spread reviews across all office locations.

Intake Optimization: Offer training to improve the firm's intake conversion rate (currently ~28% from qualified leads).

Next Steps

Jacob:

Send recap email with PI case studies and AI avatar examples.

Prepare a tailored marketing plan and pricing packages for the next call.

Invite Marketing Director Nick to the next call.

Both:

Meet on Monday, Aug 3, at 10:00 AM PT to review the proposal.

Action Items

Email Michael recap + AI avatar examples + PI case studies - WATCH (5 secs)
Prepare scoping/audit for Michael: Irvine, Sacramento, San Diego, San Bernardino, Austin; LSA/Yelp; AI avatars; site redesign - WATCH (5 secs)
